leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Construct a script that calculates the size of a JavaScript bundle file
Initialize configuration variables for maximum allowed bundle size
Implement file system operations to read and analyze build artifacts
Apply conditional logic to compare actual bundle size against limits
Configure the script to output clear warnings when size thresholds are exceeded
Integrate the guard script into a build process or package.json script
Manipulate file paths and names to target specific build outputs
